decisions.reason: Setting Danish text for a date placeholder does not change the document's default Word language configuration.
The source specifies date-placeholder wording but does not change whether text-entry placeholders clear when activated.
The date-placeholder wording does not alter cross-user rendering stability or the supported Word environment.
The source does not change legacy copy-paste behavior, expected stability, or the accepted transfer workflow.
The date-placeholder text is unrelated to containment and stability of pasted tables and columns.
The source does not change manual line-break behavior after pasted content.
The date-placeholder wording does not affect footer page-number visibility or the page on which numbering starts.
The source does not change bullet sizing, balance, alignment, color, or visual reference.
The source changes the localized text displayed for date entry but does not alter the independently tracked calendar-dropdown selection method.
Specifying date-placeholder copy does not change the architecture or representation of ordinary text-entry fields.
The source does not affect Tab-based list input, applicable list styles, or hierarchy alignment.
The Danish date-placeholder text is interface copy, not a change to style-name prefixes or their applicability.
